HediffDef.label: Godlike Efficiency
HediffDef.description: Is it magic? Archotech implants? Who knows! At the end of the day, all that really matters is that this pawn is capable of feeding or fertilizing an entire colony on its own.

HediffDef.label: Industrial efficiency
HediffDef.description: This pawn is about twice as efficient at gaining nourishment and producing materials from prey as other predators. It uses the whole muffalo.

HediffDef.label: Efficient
HediffDef.description: This pawn is about 150% as efficient at gaining nourishment and producing materials from prey as other predators. Its body just knows how to coax a little more nutrition out of the marrows and ligaments of its prey.

HediffDef.label: Normal efficiency
HediffDef.description: This pawn is as efficient as other predators.

HediffDef.label: Inefficient
HediffDef.description: This pawn is about 75% as efficient at gaining nourishment and producing materials from prey as other predators. Its body just isn't as good at breaking down all those tough, unchewed tissues into something nutritious.

HediffDef.label: Very inefficient
HediffDef.description: This pawn is about half as efficient at gaining nourishment and producing materials from prey as other predators. It needs to eat a lot of people to stay full.

HediffDef.label: Very nutritious
HediffDef.description: This pawn is about twice as nutritious as other prey. The best kind of ration around!

HediffDef.label: Nutritious
HediffDef.description: This pawn is about 150% as nutritious as other prey. It'll keep a pred full for a while.

HediffDef.label: Normal nutritiousness
HediffDef.description: This pawn is as nutritious as other prey.

HediffDef.label: Unnutritious
HediffDef.description: This pawn is about 75% as nutritious as other prey. It wouldn't make for good livestock.

HediffDef.label: Junk prey
HediffDef.description: This pawn is about half as nutritious as other prey. You'd get a better meal out of a vending machine.
